description: The edges of ADR-0125's ΔE00 band table, each as its source states it (F-222). The first two are the 50:50 % perceptibility and acceptability thresholds in CIEDE2000 units; the third is the top of the colour-difference range CIEDE2000 was built for, a secondary statement of the formula's reference range rather than a threshold of perception. Exact: the table's edges are these numbers, not approximations of them.

entries.source: Paravina RD, Pérez MM, Ghinea R (2019), "Acceptability and perceptibility thresholds in dentistry: A comprehensive review of clinical and research applications", Journal of Esthetic and Restorative Dentistry 31(2):103–112, doi:10.1111/jerd.12465, abstract: "The CIELAB 50:50% PT was ΔEab = 1.2, whereas 50:50% AT was ΔEab = 2.7. Corresponding CIEDE2000 (ΔE00) values were 0.8 and 1.8, respectively." Measured on dental ceramic (Paravina et al. 2015, J Esthet Restor Dent 27(S1):S1–S9)
Paravina RD, Pérez MM, Ghinea R (2019), Journal of Esthetic and Restorative Dentistry 31(2):103–112, doi:10.1111/jerd.12465, abstract — the 50:50% acceptability threshold, ΔE00 1.8
